crossRefs.note: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.
Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” Yahweh said to David, “Go strike…
To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death. But I will not…

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
translations.bsb: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Bring me the ephod.” So Abiathar brought it to him,
translations.kjv: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
translations.asv: And David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
